## Motus activity monitoring

Get some maps.  Connect to .motus database for a project (recently updated using code in SSRS_motus_data.Rmd).


```{r setup}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
# install.packages('tigris')
library(tigris)
library(motus)
library(openxlsx)
library(ggplot2)

options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

proj.num = 247 #  SSRS; 446 for CDFW
focal.motus = file.path("C:",
                        "Users",
                        "PatrickLorch",
                        "OneDrive - SSRS",
                        "MotusGeneral",
                        "rmotus_work",
                        "Motus-work")

```


### State outlines

We generate these to subset and count Motus stations.


```{r states}
us_states = states()
# Single state
CA_ountline_sf = us_states %>% 
  filter(STUSPS == "CA")
plot(CA_ountline_sf[7], main = "California")

# Multiple state
SW_states_outline_sf = us_states %>% 
  filter(STUSPS %in% c("AZ", "CA", "NM", "NV"))
plot(SW_states_outline_sf[7], main = "CA, AZ, NV, and NM")
```

### Connect to db and check last detection


```{r getlatest}
# use dir = to specify a directory
sql_motus = tagme(projRecv = proj.num, update = FALSE, dir = focal.motus)

tbl_recvDeps = tbl(sql_motus, "recvDeps")
unique(pull(tbl_recvDeps, status))
df_recvDeps_active = tbl_recvDeps %>%
  filter(status == "active",
         !is.na(latitude)) %>% 
  collect() %>% 
  as.data.frame()


```

### Subset by state or states polygon



```{r subsetbystate}
df_recvDeps_active_sf_4326 = st_as_sf(df_recvDeps_active, 
                                      coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), 
                                      crs = 4326)
CA_ountline_sf_4326 = st_transform(CA_ountline_sf, crs = 4326)
CA_df_recvDeps = df_recvDeps_active_sf_4326 %>%
  st_filter(CA_ountline_sf_4326, .predicate = st_intersects) %>%
  mutate(Start_deploy = as_datetime(tsStart, tz = "UTC", origin = "1970-01-01"),
         longitude = st_coordinates(geometry)[,1],
         latitude = st_coordinates(geometry)[,2],
         CA_Latest_data = NA) 
# Attempt to get rid of list error by removing lists and anything with Nan for mean
# %>%
#   select(-(c(tsEnd, macAddress, utcOffset, geometry)))

names(CA_df_recvDeps)
CA_df_recvDeps_less = as.data.frame(CA_df_recvDeps) %>%
  select(c("deployID", "serno", "receiverType",
           "deviceID", "name", "Start_deploy",
           "longitude",
           "latitude", 
           "CA_Latest_data"))
# Export to add latest data date by looking up stations by name
write.xlsx(CA_df_recvDeps_less, 
           "CA_df_recvDeps_less.xlsx")
# Bring back in
CA_df_recvDeps_less_latest = 
  read.xlsx("CA_df_recvDeps_less.xlsx", detectDates = T)
CA_df_recvDeps_less = CA_df_recvDeps_less %>%
  select(-CA_Latest_data) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
           crs = 4326)
CA_latest = CA_df_recvDeps_less_latest %>%
  select(deployID, CA_Latest_data)
CA_df_recvDeps_latest = CA_df_recvDeps_less %>%
  left_join(CA_latest, by = "deployID")

CA_df_recvDeps_latest = CA_df_recvDeps_latest %>% 
  mutate(months_old = interval(CA_Latest_data, 
                               as.Date("2026-10-16")) %/% months(1))

table(CA_df_recvDeps_latest$months_old)
CA_stations = length(na.omit(CA_df_recvDeps_latest$months_old))
CA_stations-83
(CA_dead_stations = (CA_stations-83)/CA_stations) 
# currently 24 of 107 stations (22%) marked as active 
#  have not reported data in over a month

# Fails with some wierd list error
# write.xlsx(CA_df_recvDeps,
#            file = "CA_df_recvDeps.xlsx")

plot(CA_ountline_sf_4326[7], main = "California", )
points((CA_df_recvDeps[2]), main = "CA Motus stations")
# points(CA_df_recvDeps[2])

CA_df_recvDeps_latest = CA_df_recvDeps_latest %>%
  mutate(up_to_date = ifelse(months_old >= 1, "Old (>= 1 month)", "Not old (< 1 month"))

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = CA_ountline_sf_4326[7], fill = "grey95") +
  geom_sf(data = CA_df_recvDeps_latest, aes(color = up_to_date), size = 2) +
   scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_classic()



```
